## Summary

Describe the security or governance problem and the implemented change.

## Safety boundary

- [ ] The change preserves exact scope enforcement.
- [ ] The change cannot execute arbitrary commands or payloads.
- [ ] Active behavior remains approval-gated and kill-switchable.
- [ ] No credential, customer, or production data is included.
- [ ] Audit packages contain opaque evidence metadata only.

## Validation

List tests and synthetic scenarios used to validate the change.

## Claims

- [ ] Documentation distinguishes implemented controls from design goals.
- [ ] No compliance certification or production-safety claim is made.
- [ ] Licensed standards are referenced without copying protected text.
